verdict.rationale: Milvus's own GitHub repo names pymilvus as the official Python SDK and shows MilvusClient usage, including search calls. The docs add that the same client code runs unchanged on Lite, Standalone and Distributed deployments, so the core of the story is clearly delivered. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond Python (e.g. Java, Go, Node), no OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and no independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
